analysis:
In the first week of January 2011, Telecom Minister Kapil Sibal held a press conference at which he disputed the Comptroller and Auditor General's reading of the 2008 2G spectrum allocation, saying there was "no loss at all" to the exchequer and calling the CAG's loss projection presumptive and "utterly erroneous".

The CAG's Report No. 19 of 2010, a performance audit tabled on 16 November 2010, estimated a presumptive loss of about Rs 1.76 lakh crore from the January 2008 issue of 120 licences at 2001 prices. The CBI's charge-sheet later put the loss at Rs 30,984 crore.

Reporting at the time records that the Supreme Court declined to take cognisance of the minister's stand. The Audit Report page confirms the report's tabling date and its findings on the allocation process; the precise loss figure appears in the report itself.
